questions.q: Which word is formed correctly from "appear + dis-"
questions.why: Disappear means go out of sight.

questions.q: Which word is formed correctly from "agree + dis-"
questions.why: Disagree means not agree.

questions.q: Which word is formed correctly from "write + re-"
questions.why: Rewrite means write again.

questions.q: Which word is formed correctly from "play + re-"
questions.why: Replay means play again.

questions.q: Which word is formed correctly from "cycle + bi-"
questions.why: A bicycle has two wheels.

questions.q: Which word is formed correctly from "view + re-"
questions.why: Review means look at again.

questions.q: Which word is formed correctly from "heat + -er"
questions.why: Heater names something that heats.

questions.q: Which word is formed correctly from "dark + -ness"
questions.why: Darkness is the noun form of dark.
